stories.title: Power Rankings: How teams stack up after free agen...
stories.summary: Let's see where all 30 teams stand after a flurry of free agency and trade moves this offseason.

stories.title: 49ers' Shanahan to be limited in camp after crash
stories.summary: 49ers coach Kyle Shanahan suffered significant injuries in a car crash during his summer break in mid-July that will leave him limited as the team opens training camp.

stories.title: Donald's possible return has LA's McVay 'excited'
stories.summary: Coach Sean McVay said former Rams defensive tackle Aaron Donald is putting himself through a "very strict, regimented process" as he considers a return to the playing field.

stories.title: Kraft: Pats offer Gonzalez richest CB deal ever
stories.summary: Robert Kraft says the Patriots have made an offer to cornerback Christian Gonzalez that would "make him the highest-paid player to ever play that position in the NFL."

stories.title: Mets' Soto hits 10-day IL with left calf strain
stories.summary: New York Mets slugger Juan Soto was placed on the 10-day injured list on Saturday because of a left calf strain.
